name: Absolute Zero
traits: Boss Assassin II; Air Critical Strike II; Prison of Ice
obs_notes: AIR CRITICAL STRIKE II identified 2026-09-05 (the Royal Family named the tier: 50% x4). UPGRADE OF SHADOW (owner-confirmed 2026-09-05). THE ANTI-BOSS TOWER, and it ties the armour-type data together: wave 5 (a BOSS wave) was observed with armour type "hero", and this tower does x8 vs heroes. So "hero" armour marks the boss and this is the built answer to it. THE FREEZE IS THE HEADLINE: 3.5s freeze on a 2.5s attack cycle = 1.4x uptime = PERMANENT lockdown of a single target, which on a boss is a hard counter rather than a damage boost. 2500 per hit is the largest single hit recorded in any kit. CONFIRMED 2026-09-05: the x8 hero line is Boss Assassin II, whose chance is 50% - so the 26.60 figure is no longer provisional.
